query: I'm evaluating an 88‑year‑old male. Among male patients 83–93 with ACS, stratified by 1–4 vs 5–7 day stay and primary vs secondary diagnosis, what are mean, min, max ultrasounds per admission?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, CAST(p.anchor_age AS INT) AS age, s.stay_length, d.diagnosis_type, COUNT(DISTINCT u.procedure_id) AS num_ultrasounds FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN icustays s ON a.stay_id = s.stay_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN procedures_icd u ON a.subject_id = u.subject_id AND u.chartdate BETWEEN p.dod AND (p.dod + interval '7 days') WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND CAST(p.anchor_age AS INT) BETWEEN 83 AND 93 AND s.stay_length BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND d.icd_code = 'ACS' GROUP BY p.gender, age, stay_length, diagnosis_type ORDER BY p.gender, age, stay_length, diagnosis_type NULLS LAST;
